heading: INT. RENTED BANQUET HALL, AFTER THE WAKE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. RENTED BANQUET HALL, AFTER THE WAKE - NIGHT
Folding tables, half-eaten trays of rice and plantain, balloons that nobody wanted.
A photograph of a smiling old man leans against a speaker on the stage.
DELPHINE ABARA, forties, sits alone at the head table pulling the tinsel off a centerpiece.
Her brother ROMUALD, fifties, enters from the kitchen with a stack of paper plates and a bottle.
Their aunt GERTIE, seventies, is asleep upright in a chair by the coat rack.
NKEM, Delphine's teenage son, crouches by the door, folding chairs one at a time.
He sets down the plates.
She does not look up.
Your car is still in the lot. The hall wants it moved.
units.name: ROMUALD

units.text: Tell them I'll move it when I'm done.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: Done with what?
units.name: ROMUALD

units.text: She holds up a fistful of tinsel.
He pours two plastic cups and slides one to her.
She pushes it back.
He drinks both.
You gave a good speech.
units.name: ROMUALD

units.text: I read it off a napkin.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: That's why it was good.
units.name: ROMUALD

units.text: She laughs, short and ugly.
He sits beside her, not too close.
Across the room Gertie snores once and settles.
Nkem drops a chair with a clang.
Everyone freezes.
Gertie opens one eye, looks at all three, and closes it again.
Sorry.
units.name: NKEM

units.text: Nkem, come here.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: He walks over, hands in pockets.
She takes his chin in her hand, studies him, and lets go.
He looks at his shoes.
Delphine, the will.
units.name: ROMUALD

units.text: Not tonight.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: I'm only saying the house is
units.name: ROMUALD

units.text: Romuald. Not tonight.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: He raises both hands.
She stands, takes the photograph off the stage, and carries it down the aisle, past Gertie and past Nkem, who steps aside without being asked.
Romuald watches her go, then picks up the bottle and follows.
Nkem, left alone, folds the last chair and leans it gently against the wall.
Somebody turn the lights off before they bill us.
units.name: GERTIE

units.text: Nkem does.
